en.headline: Government appoints Chan Kin-por as Hospital Authority chairman
en.dek: The Chief Executive appointed Chan Kin-por as chairman of the Hospital Authority for a two-year term from 1 December, with one new member and six reappointments.
body: The government announced on Monday that the Chief Executive has appointed Chan Kin-por as chairman of the Hospital Authority under the Hospital Authority Ordinance, effective from 1 December for two years.

Chan is currently a member of the Executive Council, an independent non-executive director of Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing, and chairman of the Independent Commission Against Corruption Advisory Committee on Corruption. He will resign from his roles as non-executive director of the Urban Renewal Authority and director of CUHK Medical Centre before taking up the post.

Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau welcomed the appointment, saying Chan's extensive experience in politics, public service, policy formulation, resource management and corporate governance would help lead public healthcare reforms and enhance governance standards.

zh.headline: 政府委任陳健波為醫管局主席 12月1日起任期兩年
zh.dek: 行政長官根據《醫院管理局條例》委任陳健波為醫管局主席，任期由12月1日起為期兩年，同時委任一名新成員及再度委任六名現任成員。
body: 政府周一公布，行政長官委任陳健波為醫院管理局主席，任期由2026年12月1日起生效，為期兩年。
陳健波現為行政會議成員、港交所獨立非執行董事及廉政公署貪污問題諮詢委員會主席。他將在履職前辭任市區重建局非執行董事及中文大學醫院董事職務。
醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂歡迎有關委任，指陳健波擁有豐富從政及公共服務經驗，有助帶領醫管局推動公營醫療改革及提升管治水平。
